basic_details.short_information: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi (AUD), New Delhi, has invited applications for 56 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. No.AUD/55-1(127)/Rect./2026/1008. The posts include Internal Audit Officer, System Administrator (IT), Section Officer, Senior Assistant and 4 more. Applications are accepted online until 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AUD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Departmental candidates who are in the feeder cadre and in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration on deputation.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Officers from Government Departments/ Institutions/ Autonomous Organizations/ Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) having experience of working in Finance/ Accounts/ Audit in analogous posts in Level 12, or Level 11 with 3 years' experience, or Level 10 with 5 years' experience. Experience required: Analogous posts in Level 12, or Level 11 with 3 years' experience, or Level 10 with 5 years' experience. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level-12 of 7th CPC. Qualification required: Post graduate Degree in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ B.Tech or Master's in Computer Applications (MCA) with at least 55% marks; Professional certification from Microsoft/ Oracle/ Cisco/ Sun/ Red Hat. Experience required: At least 5 years' experience in managing network and installation of packages in University/ Government/ Public/ Private Organization of repute. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level-10 of 7th CPC. Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree with at least 50% marks OR Graduate with at least 50% marks. Experience required: 3 years' experience for Post Graduates or 5 years' experience for Graduates in responsible position equivalent to Sr. Assistant level in relevant field. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Level-7 of 7th CPC. Qualification required: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience required: At least five years of relevant experience in PB-1, GP Rs.2400 (6th CPC) / Level-4 (7th CPC) in Central/State Govt/University/Autonomous Body/Public Sector or comparable experience. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Level-6 of 7th CPC. Qualification required: B. Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing from a recognized University or Institute; Registered as Nurse or Nurse and Midwife with Indian Nursing Council and State Nursing Council. Experience required: Six months' experience in Minimum fifty bedded hospitals after acquiring the educational qualification. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Level-6 of 7th CPC. Qualification required: Bachelors / Master's degree in Physical education; Diploma in Sports Coaching or an equivalent qualification from a recognized University/ Institution. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Level-5 of 7th CPC. Qualification required: Bachelor's Degree in Library Science/ Library & Information Science from a recognized University; Knowledge of computer applications; Typing speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minutes in Hindi on Computer. Age limit: Maximum 27 years. Pay: Level-3 of 7th CPC. Qualification required: 10+2 or equivalent from a recognized Board; Typing speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minutes in Hindi on Computer. Age limit: Maximum 27 years. Pay: Level-2 of 7th CPC.

content_sections.text: The initial period of deputation shall be 1 year, extendable as per extant rules, subject to review of performance.

content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online through credit / debit card / net banking / payment gateway.

content_sections.text: Test / Interview as decided by the University University may restrict the number of candidates to a reasonable limit on the basis of qualifications/experience higher than the minimum prescribed.

content_sections.text: Dates of test/interview notified on website and via email

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Necessary documents justifying the claim of respective reservation No Objection Certificate from employer for serving candidates Vigilance Clearance Certificate for deputation candidates Attested copies of ACRs / APARs for preceding five years for deputation candidates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AUD Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Application forms have to be filled mandatorily in online mode on the website of the University. Access the online job portal at https://aud.delhi.gov.in/#careers. Applicants applying for more than one post must apply separately and pay fees separately. Make online payment through credit / debit card / net banking / payment gateway. Apply on or before 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates should possess the essential qualifications as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for AUD Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi has announced a total of 56 vacancies for various non-teaching positions across different departments, ranging from administrative roles to specialized technical and support staff roles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AUD Delhi recruitment is 06 November 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the AUD Delhi non-teaching recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must visit the official website of the university to fill out the application form and upload the necessary documents as per the instructions.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent or deputation-based recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the official notification, these positions are being filled on a deputation basis. Interested candidates currently working in similar government roles are eligible to apply for these positions at the university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the various positions ranges from Level-2 to Level-12 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. The specific salary level depends on the post applied for, such as Level-12 for Audit Officer and Level-2 for Junior Assistants.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the official notification provided, there is no application fee mentioned for the AUD Delhi recruitment. Candidates should verify this information on the official portal during the final submission process.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from other states apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from across India who meet the eligibility criteria and possess the required qualifications and experience as specified in the notification are eligible to apply for these positions in Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. How will the selection be conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process details are outlined in the official notification. Candidates are encouraged to download the PDF from the official website to understand the specific criteria and stages involved in the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF is available on the official website of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi at https://aud.delhi.gov.in. You can also refer to the important links section provided in this article for direct access.

faq.question: Q10. What should I do if I face issues while applying online?
faq.answer: If you encounter any technical difficulties while filling out the online form, you should contact the official helpdesk or support email provided on the AUD Delhi official website for immediate assistance and guidance.
